description: Enumerate the known subdomains of a single domain, with first-/last-seen timestamps per subdomain. Use this for attack-surface mapping on a target organisation's apex domain. Can return tens of thousands of rows, so it is paginated: keep calling with "next_page_token" copied from the previous response for as long as "has_more" is true, and you will walk the whole set — including past the upstream's 10000-per-request cap. "total_count" counts the rows currently fetched, NOT the size of the whole result set: the upstream offers no total, so the only way to know it is to page to the end. Do NOT use this for searching domains or subdomains by name pattern (use `domain_and_subdomain_discovery`) or for processing many apex domains at once (use `bulk_subdomain_lookup`).

domain_name.description: Domain name to lookup subdomains for.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-500, default 500). Ignored when "next_page_token" is supplied: a continuation keeps the page size the walk started with, so change it only on the first call.

next_page_token.description: IMPORTANT: To fetch the next page, copy the "next_page_token" value from the previous response and pass it here. Do not use "search_after" or any other parameter name - only "next_page_token" is accepted.

name: subdomain_lookup
